name: streamingSpreadsheetRead
description: Reads a sheet from an Excel file using streaming and returns it as a query, CSV string or HTML string.

params.name: source
params.description: File path of the spreadsheet to read.

params.name: options
params.description: Struct of read options. Keys: sheetName, format (query, csv or html), headerRow, rows, columns, destinationFilePath, excludeHeaderRow, randomAccessWindowSize.
